subject: zunionInterDiffGenericCommand use ztrycalloc to avoid OOM panic (#13052)
reason: This is an OOM-hardening change: zcalloc of the transient src table in zunionInterDiffGenericCommand (ZUNION/ZINTER/ZDIFF and *STORE/ZINTERCARD) is replaced by ztrycalloc with a NULL check returning an error instead of aborting. Its only observable difference from the parent is when that specific allocation fails: the parent calls the OOM handler and crashes, the change replies with an error. For every allocation that succeeds (every normal input) behavior is byte-for-byte identical, so a compared command sequence would show equal replies on both builds and never reach the change.
